diagnosis: Checks C1, C3, and C7 are leaking because the lone decision-maker can satisfy them using general professional heuristics. Specifically, when presented with a conflict regarding forum structure (S1-S4), models default to 'structured discussion with a neutral facilitator' (C1) and 'prohibiting cold-calling' (C3/C7) as standard best practices for resolving workplace friction, regardless of whether Taylor's specific arrangement (PF1) was known.

C1.why: Taylor's approved arrangement changes the forum to a structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator, sets the agenda notice threshold to at least 48 hours, changes cold-calling from allowed to prohibited, and requires those terms to be incorporated into the operating charter.

C3.why: Taylor's approved arrangement changes the forum to a structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator, sets the agenda notice threshold to at least 48 hours, changes cold-calling from allowed to prohibited, and requires those terms to be incorporated into the operating charter.

C7.why: Taylor's approved arrangement changes the forum to a structured discussion with a designated neutral facilitator, sets the agenda notice threshold to at least 48 hours, changes cold-calling from allowed to prohibited, and requires those terms to be incorporated into the operating charter.
